description_expanded: Just another day in paradise at High Pointe 432, a stunning condo located in the private gated community of High Pointe in Inlet Beach! With a lagoon-style pool, tennis and pickleball courts, a playground, and more, each day brings something new. Surrounded by lush palms, gorgeous grounds, and showcasing incredible views of the pool and the Gulf of Mexico, this retreat has it all! Bikes are available year-round and 1 Beach Chair setup (2 chairs and 1 umbrella) are included courtesy of La Dolce Vita March 1st through October 31st! Just let the on-site staff know which condo you are staying in! High Pointe 432 is a gorgeous condo with two bedrooms and two baths accommodating up to eight. Brimming with natural light and impeccably designed, this stunning retreat checks every vacation box. Beautiful artwork adorns the walls of each room and cozy furnishings welcome you in for a peaceful and relaxing stay. Lounge on the sofa in the living room, pull up the occasional chairs, and catch up on your favorite shows. Better yet, step out onto the private balcony, enjoy coastal breezes, and take in stunning views of the pool and Gulf of Mexico! When the crew gets hungry, you’ll have no problem whipping up amazing creations in the beautifully appointed kitchen with state-of-the art-appliances, plenty of counter and cabinet space, and a breakfast bar with seating for four. Gather together at the dining table for delicious meals or just spend time together playing cards and board games. You’ll have no problem relaxing in the master suite, featuring a kig-sized bed, flat-screen TV, en suite bath, and private access to the balcony. The kids will enjoy their own space in the bunk room, featuring cozy bedding, plenty of closet space, and a flat-screen TV. A full-sized washer and dryer makes clean ups a breeze in this gorgeous retreat perfectly suited for a family getaway! Soak up the sun by the pool, challenge one another to friendly tennis and pickleball games, and let the kids burn off that extra energy on the playground. Grab a snack at the on-site restaurant, Crabby Steve’s, then head to the beach for hours of waterplay! Whether shopping in Rosemary Beach, dining at Alys Beach, or kayaking on Lake Powell, you’ll never run out of things to do inlet Beach! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
